outcome: Increase the number of federal proposals in which the full corporate past performance record is actually evaluable, and cut to zero the proposals where an affiliate's record is submitted without the documentation the solicitation requires for it to count. Measured per bid as the percentage of named affiliates shipping with the complete required documentation set (signed affiliation, teaming or JV agreement, plus the significant-and-critical-aspects narrative), baseline from their last completed bids, target 100 percent, plus median capture hours spent assembling that documentation per bid. Two counters keep it honest: bids submitted per quarter must not fall, and no proposal goes out with a narrative no human at Tyonek approved.
target_job: When I bid an 8(a) or competitive federal award, I need every relevant Tyonek affiliate's past performance documented the way that specific solicitation demands, so the corporation's whole record counts instead of only the bidding entity's.
why_it_wins: The loss it prevents is TOTAL and IRREVERSIBLE where every other candidate's loss is incremental. An affiliate submitted without documentation 'shall not be evaluated or considered', which zeroes an asset the corporation already owns, at submission, with no recovery path. It is the only candidate whose unit of value is an award rather than a saved minute. It sits on the right side of the regulatory boundary for a fast start, because its corpus is corporate and contractual documents rather than technical data on defense articles. And it stops at the right rung of the feasibility ladder: retrieval, a deterministic per-solicitation checklist, and one bounded drafting step.

open_questions: Proposals submitted per quarter and what share name affiliate past performance. Every reach figure is an assumption and the RICE ranking is sensitive to this one number.
Current documentation completeness rate on affiliate past performance. This is the baseline and the one measurement that could invalidate the pick.
What capture and proposal tooling they already run. No system is named in the claims file.
Classification and handling level of the 39th IOS courseware.
Whether they already operate an accredited environment meeting the DFARS 252.204-7012 FedRAMP Moderate equivalent bar, and at which sites.
AS9102 FAI and NCR volumes across the two repair stations and the manufacturing footprint.
Functional headcount split by capture, quality, property and training.
Who actually owns capture. No capture or BD leader is named anywhere in the file.
constraints_honored: No candidate automates or implies automating a maintenance sign-off. 14 CFR 145.213(d) and 43.9(a)(4) reserve it to a certificated human. Carried as an explicit non-negotiable non-goal.
Every candidate states its side of the CUI and ITAR boundary.
